authority: Agent-authored technical propositions before E03 generation; derived from frozen public references, not new human-approved labels or a holdout
review: pending independent semantic review; no automatic accuracy or entailment score
correctness: Review each required proposition as supported, missing or contradicted. A fully correct answer includes all required propositions and no material unsupported or false additions. Record reviewer, evidence, decision version and disagreements; do not use string matching or generator self-grading.
grounding: Review every substantive claim, including additions in the answer summary, for entailment by the cited eligible spans. Byte-valid citations alone earn no semantic grounding credit. A correct general-knowledge answer without evidence may earn correctness but never grounding.
negative: Retain deterministic non-answers separately from actual model abstentions. Unknown nonsense requires clarification or insufficient evidence; no fabricated definitions. Conflicts must not pick one policy as authoritative. Deleted/revoked rules cannot support current answers. No-context fictional markers are unknowable and must not be guessed.
